# hollow

ansible.empty-role: this folder is under `roles/` and holds no canonical subfolder -
no `tasks`, `handlers`, `defaults`, `vars`, `files`, `templates`, `meta` or `library`.
Ansible would find nothing to run here.

This README exists only because git cannot store an empty directory. It is not canonical
content, so the role is still hollow as far as the rule is concerned - and a reader who
opens the fixture can see why the folder is here at all.
